sceneWideRequiredChecks: Apply output-medium gate before subject vocabulary: education WEBSITE is not educational POST; coffee WEBSITE is not menu/promotional IMAGE; video reference packaging is not packaging DESIGN.
logo-design must request new logo concepts/system or explicit approved-logo art adaptation. Existing-logo placement, platform headers and logo in negative text fail.
packaging-design must actually design packaging/structure/label or expand intentional packaging mockup. Existing product reference locks and lighting descriptions fail.
promotional-campaigns direct requires actual campaign/offer/event/CTA. General commercial mood can be adaptable with specific notes, not direct.
product-launches requires launch of product, not Apple-keynote visual style applied to nature.
short-video-covers must target cover as full deliverable, not thumbnails nested in UI. YouTube thumbnails need short-video crop/format adaptation.
digital-publications is severely overbroad: editorial/magazine style, books as props and standalone infographics do not establish ebooks/publication deliverables. Reaudit all108.
interactive-product-showcases requires product-showcase purpose and interaction, not every interactive app/chart/knowledge-base site.
lead-magnets direct requires an offered downloadable/free resource and lead-capture exchange; SaaS signup/newsletter/CV link alone fails.
cafe-bakery requires cafe/bakery as principal business or product target. Coffee TABLE and incidental cup are exclusions.
couple-keepsakes requires couple as principal emotional/personalized subject, not one travel-ad quadrant or incidental park visitor.
art-prints must have poster/print product rationale; illustration alone should not auto-map banner sets, concept sheets or every image. Reaudit all237.

Adaptation notes must state actual bridge: crop/layout, personalized reference, real offer/CTA, printed output specifications. Generic replace subject/brand is insufficient for nontrivial medium or purpose changes.
WeChat cover814 source taxonomy adaptation approved by parent: maintain source reconstruction disclosure and cover crop/readability notes, not infer native platform origin.
All-scene source evidence spans should contain complete semantic target, not truncated substrings around incidental match words.
